title: GitHub search results for issues related to FileAccess save regression in Godot engine
key_points: The API returned a total of 19 matching issues
The issues are related to a regression in the Godot engine's FileAccess functionality when saving files
One example issue reports that a sync filesystem operation should be added before rename during atomic writes to prevent data loss
Another issue reports a bug where OBJ file import settings are not honored and the .scn file references the .material file only after manual re-importing
A third issue reports that Godot output sometimes misses logs before quit(), but console shows all output
limitations: The source only provides a list of related issues without detailed analysis or solutions
The scope and impact of these issues on the overall Godot engine functionality is not clearly described in the search results
Further investigation of each issue would be needed to fully understand the implications and potential fixes
asserts: There are currently 19 open issues related to a FileAccess save regression in the Godot game engine, impacting atomic write functionality and logged output.
scope: The keying search terms (repo:godotengine/godot +FileAccess +save +regression) were used to filter relevant issues from the Godot engine's GitHub issue tracker. The provided results pertain specifically to this subset of reported engine bugs and regressions in save behavior.
